purpose: software verification; not regulation acceptance tolerances

nativeGeometryMetres.note: Does not authorize forced merging; domain-specific tighter limits may be required.

printedRounding: raw printed number +/- half of last printed place; sum raw available inputs before display
criticalLimitDecision: unrounded value; a decision changing side cannot be hidden by total tolerance
changePolicy: New physical benchmark may define a justified separate scale/norm before observation; never relax a failing target to fit source output.
